description: Reads the clock at a place and instant and returns the moment card (digit-reduced local HH:MM read as a Major Arcana number), whether this minute is a portal, and the previous and next portal minutes (mirrors, triples, ascending/descending sequences, pi 3:14, phi 6:18, and 12-hour echoes) with exact UTC instants and countdowns. Clock: civil timezone (given, or looked up from the coordinate), mean solar time, or UTC. DST-aware. Same input and "at" always give the same result, with a receipt hash. Price: $0.01 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

at.description: Optional UTC instant, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:30Z. Defaults to now.

clock.description: Optional. civil (default), solar (mean solar time at the longitude) or utc.

timezoneId.description: Optional IANA timezone, e.g. "Africa/Cairo". If omitted, it is looked up from the coordinate (falls back to solar time).

name: time_portal
title: Time portal (moment card and portal minutes)
